name: Sawatari Honoka
source:
Honoka lives in Sapporo (札幌) Hokkaido, and goes to Shouou Gakuen (祥桜学園). She's a third year student in class 3.

She likes to go window shopping, and is in the horseback riding club at school, she likes taking care of horses.
